Messages.Author: Vincent
Messages.Body:
Hi,

Does Qadir's sect change when he changes his clan?

Qadir ul-Ghani
Clan: Assamite (group 2)
Capacity: 9
Disciplines: CEL OBF QUI nec tha
Independent: Qadir may change his clan to a clan of his choosing as a
+1 stealth action that costs 1 blood. +1 bleed. (Blood Cursed)

What if he was Sabbat just before, thanks to a Into the Fire?

Into the Fire
Type: Master
Master. Trifle.
Choose a ready non-Sabbat vampire you control. That vampire becomes
Sabbat. (His or her clan is not affected.)

And what about the RTR http://groups.google.com/group/rec.games.trading-cards.jyhad/msg/3f413d99b4e1907c
?

Thanks

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
On May 26, 12:37 pm, Vincent <v.rip...@gmail.com> wrote:
> Hi,
>
> Does Qadir's sect change when he changes his clan?

Same as anyone's: his sect changes to the default sect of the clan.
[10]

> Qadir ul-Ghani
> Clan: Assamite (group 2)
> Capacity: 9
> Disciplines: CEL OBF QUI nec tha
> Independent: Qadir may change his clan to a clan of his choosing as a
> +1 stealth action that costs 1 blood. +1 bleed. (Blood Cursed)
>
> What if he was Sabbat just before, thanks to a Into the Fire?

No difference: when he changes clan, his sect becomes the default sect
of that clan.

>
> Into the Fire
> Type: Master
> Master. Trifle.
> Choose a ready non-Sabbat vampire you control. That vampire becomes
> Sabbat. (His or her clan is not affected.)
>

> And what about the RTRhttp://groups.google.com/group/rec.games.trading-cards.jyhad/msg/3f41...
> ?

It still holds.

Messages.Author: OldFan
Messages.Body:


No offense Scott, but this makes absolutely NO sense to me.

I can see, when making kids (Embrace, Bamba, Becoming, 3rd Trad), that
there must be some default mechanism for determining said newly-
created vampire's sect.

HOWEVER - why does Qadir NOT remain an Independent vampire of whatever
clan he chooses?

Lots of clans in the game have members that are of different sects,
whether that be Cam, Sabbat, Laibon, or Independent.

So,

Question: purely from a rules perspective, exactly WHAT is it about
Qadir ul-Ghani's special text that causes him to cease being an
independent vampire?

And - on a side note - does using Clan Impersonation also change the
acting vampire's sect to the chosen clan's "default".

Seriously confused and consternated,
-Asif Chaudhry
